Q5910.reason: A recorded general plan's restriction on building binds later owners with notice and is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude.

Q5623.reason: The footage showed a real public protest and the remarks were opinion on a matter of public concern, so the broadcast was privileged and the professor likely loses.

Q5004.reason: The class gift can vest more than 21 years after any life in being, and the church-use condition has no time limit, so it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities. The gift is void and the friend holds the lot alone.
